Then reason: The key textual information is “In this season, the isotherms over the North American continent protrude southward.” In winter, continents cool quickly; the southward protrusion of the isotherms over the North American continent indicates that the North American continent is colder than the ocean at the same latitude, so the Northern Hemisphere is in winter.
